fact: On 12 May 2026 NIPAM hosted its first Executive Readiness for AI in the Public Sector seminar, part of plans to introduce structured three to five-day AI training programmes for public servants at all levels, and its May 2026 course list offers Cybersecurity Fundamentals and Microsoft Excel (Basic).
title: NIPAM Bulletin May 2026
publisher: Namibia Institute of Public Administration and Management (NIPAM)
